item: The consent ratchet's scan reaches one hop, and the routes it finds join the table: three defects pinned (source preflight, RSS discovery, topic discovery)
summary: The scan of src/api now reaches EXACTLY one hop: a handler that calls a function which itself names a fetch primitive, resolved through an import from a src module or a function in its own file (never a bare method name), plus guarded_session as a primitive. Rows record how they are found (direct, hop, hand); a hand row must stay invisible to the scan, so a scan that learns to see it forces the row to be reclassified, and a test pins that the governments load and the stats fetch (two hops) are NOT found. New rows: consent for the weather context, the stats figures fetch, the governments load, the Wikidata items fetch and the three discovery jobs (each client awaits ensureOnline before its request); named for the hazards relay, the signals hazards snapshot and resolve-qid-names (each proved by a real refusal); consent rows for the bulk qualification and the scheduler start and run-now (the crossing online itself); and three GAP rows for defects the work found: POST /api/sources/preflight in airplane mode records every enabled source as unreachable, writes the preflight log (which marks the first-run preflight done) and lists the sources under unreachable, and POST /api/sources/discover/rss answers Discovered RSS feeds for 0 sources for sources it never asked about. POST /api/sources/discover/topic (with its opt-in setting on) answers Discovered 0 sources for topic because the DuckDuckGo wrapper swallows the kill switch. The preflight also overwrites each source's learned robots_allowed with None. All are pinned as they behave today and proposed as their own fix PRs (R189). The consent test now follows the row's route (the first api( call that asks for THAT route must come after a USED await ensureOnline), every row must name a routed handler that exists, and following_session and GuardedSession are primitives. Stated limits: two-hop and method-on-object fetchers stay invisible; the wiki-dump, OSM-download and AI-install managers are not in the table. Mutants: a consent call removed, a new hop route, the hop branches disabled, a gap fixed, a discarded answer, a renamed hand handler and a client moved to another route all fail the right test.
